narr: An upper level ridge was centered over the Texas Coast with an upper-low pressure system over Northern California. A dryline was across portions of Southeast New Mexico and West Texas. High moisture and instability were present to the east of the dryline. Wind shear was moderate, and an upper level disturbance moved over the area which provided additional lift. These conditions resulted in thunderstorms that produced large hail, strong winds, and flash flooding across portions of West Texas.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in Fort Stockton. There was street/road flooding and closures. Vehicles were stranded. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.

Heavy rain fell across Pecos County and produced flash flooding in Fort Stockton. There was around two feet of standing water at a low water crossing on the south end of Fort Stockton. No damage was reported.
